definition: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge 2012, a competition to estimate the content of photographs for the purpose of retrieval and automatic annotation using a subset of the large hand-labeled ImageNet dataset (10,000,000 labeled images depicting 10,000+ object categories) as training.
details: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge 2012, a competition to estimate the content of photographs for the purpose of retrieval and automatic annotation using a subset of the large hand-labeled ImageNet dataset (10,000,000 labeled images depicting 10,000+ object categories) as training.

explainer.lead: ILSVRC2012 is the 2012 ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge, a competition to estimate photograph content for retrieval and automatic annotation. It matters as a large, hand-labeled benchmark for training.

tiers.eli5: It is a big contest where computers look at photos and guess what is in them, practising on ten million labelled pictures.
tiers.practitioner: Teams train on the challenge's labeled ImageNet subset for retrieval and annotation tasks. Treat the training subset as separate from any held-out evaluation data.
tiers.paperLevel: A competition using a subset of ImageNet (10,000,000 labeled images, 10,000+ object categories) as training data. Scope is limited to that subset and category set.

explainer.example: A model learns from the labeled ImageNet images to name the object category in a new photograph, as in retrieval and automatic annotation.
